start: A member with a running plan at one MettleUp gym, welcome screen

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with your phone number'
user_sees: 'If your gym uses MettleUp, it may already have your number. We use it to find your gym and link this app to it.'
'Your mobile number'
'Your first name, as your gym has it'
'Check with WhatsApp'
must_not: Other ways shown before 'Try another way'

steps.action: Type the number and first name, tick the 18+ box, tap 'Check with WhatsApp'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with a message to MettleUp ready
'Send the message in WhatsApp'
must_not: A message sent without the member tapping send

steps.action: Send it and come back
user_sees: 'Looking for your gym...'
'Opening <gym>…'
The app opens in the gym, no setup questions
must_not: A second join after a double tap

steps.action: Finish the WhatsApp check
user_sees: 'We found you at 2 gyms. Pick the gym to open in the app.'
A card per gym with 'Join <gym>'
must_not: A gym where the member is not known

steps.action: Tap 'Join <gym>' on one
user_sees: 'Opening <gym>…'

start: A member on 'Continue with your phone number'

steps.action: Type 9 digits and tap 'Check with WhatsApp'
user_sees: 'Type your 10-digit mobile number.'

steps.action: Type the number, leave the name empty
user_sees: 'Type your first name, as your gym has it.'

steps.action: Check a number no gym has
user_sees: 'We did not find your number at a gym on MettleUp'
'Set up the app'
'Try another number'

start: A member waiting for the WhatsApp check

steps.action: Send the message after the check ran out of time
user_sees: 'The check ran out of time. Tap Start again.'

steps.action: Search too many times
user_sees: 'You searched too many times with this check. Tap Start again.'

steps.action: Join with no internet
user_sees: 'That did not work. Try again.' with the card still there
must_not: A joined gym shown when the join failed

start: A member after the phone check

steps.action: Finish the check and open Profile
user_sees: Profile's mobile number empty until typed there
must_not: The proven number kept in Profile
WhatsApp messages sent to the number later

steps.action: Read the privacy line on the form
user_sees: 'We only use your number to find your gym. Your number is checked once and is not kept for this.'
'You pay nothing, and we never message you.'
